sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be performed 
every 12:16 years as 
indicated by Y12:16 in the title block

The technical 
of the circuit breaker: Rated current = 2000A, Short-circuit = 40kA/3 second, Pneumatic mechanism.

The first draft initiated by eng. Soliman Abdel Fatah Soliman at High Dam Power 
Station, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad: general director, approved 
by eng. Abdel-Karem Abu Zaid: High Dam head Sector, and certified by eng. Kamel 
Ragheb Haleem: EPGC quality control general director, MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

items:
Wear 
 standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, rubber gloves, ... etc.
Switch off the disconnectors on CB sides and grounded the CB sides
Switch off DC & AC supply (CB is electrically dead)

Switch off the charging current DC motor wound 
 spring
The CB in not under pressure (all compressed air is released)

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Portable air blower, metal brush
Suction - evacuation service cart
Telescope crane & lifting crane
Set of common screw drivers, and cleaning material (arg, cloth)
(G,K) greases for lubricating

Electronic breaker timing analyzer (analyzer TM 1600 / MA 31) micrometer and 
 water pump

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Steps before maintenance

Isolate the terminals of 
(closing, opening) coils of CB from main cabinet for all CB phases

Connect the external DC 
supply to (closing & opening) coil for CB phases

items:
Isolate the terminals of 
(closing, opening) coils of CB from main cabinet for all CB phases

Connect the external DC 
supply to (closing & opening) coil for CB phases

Connect the AC 
 supply of air compressors

Measurement (close - 
 open) times, of CB

Disconnect AC 
 supply off air compressors and test the air protection devices during 
 release the compressed air from the CB

Switch of the 
 external DC supply and AC supply

Record counter 
 reading of operation counter and no of operation hours of compressors

Measurement the DC 
 resistance of contacts of CB

Test (dew point, air 
 volume percentage & decomposition products) of the SF6 gas

Suction the SF6 gas 
 from the CB

sections.text: Steps of Dismantling and Maintenance

items:
Dismantle the terminals 
from the both sides of CB

Dismantle the twin head 
- dismantle the capacitors and transport the twin head to work shop

Measure the capacitance 
of the capacitors

Dismantle the parallel (preinsertion) 
resistors from twin head end measure the resistance

Check and maintenance 
the mechanism and moving contacts of resistors

Check the presence of 
overheat and flashover on breaking units components

Check the presence of 
surface defects or cracks on breaking units components

Dismantle the (moving 
stationary) contacts of interrupters, clean and lubricate the (puffer cyl., 
arcing pins, crown)

Inspect the external 
insulator of breaking units

Replace the old o-rings 
by new o-rings before mounting the all parts of twin head and parallel resistors

sections.text: Steps before Mounting the Twin Head on C

Measure the resistance of 
parallel resistors and compare it by the previous reading

Dismantle and maintenance 
(actuator, closing value, opening value, solenoid valve, aux. - switch, 
interlock close piston) of pneumatic mechanism (lubricate all parts and 
new-o-ring)

Transport twin head from 
workshop to site of CB and mantle it

Mantle all parts of 
pneumatic mechanism of step (24)

Check and inspect the 
insulation of support column and its tightening

Repeat all steps (11 to 
28) every twin head and pneumatic mechanism of all C.B Phases respectively

items:

parallel resistors and compare it by the previous reading

Dismantle and maintenance 
(actuator, closing value, opening value, solenoid valve, aux. - switch, 
interlock close piston) of pneumatic mechanism (lubricate all parts and 
new-o-ring)

Transport twin head from 
workshop to site of CB and mantle it

Mantle all parts of 
pneumatic mechanism of step (24)

Check and inspect the 
insulation of support column and its tightening

Repeat all steps (11 to 
28) every twin head and pneumatic mechanism of all C.B Phases respectively

sections.text: Steps of Maintenance of air Compressors

items:
Check the air values and 
chang the oil

Check the air filter and 
safety valves

Check the all air 
pistons

Change o-rings and 
gaskets for air-pipelines

Check the all components 
of control cabinet

Switch on air 
compressore to fill the receivers by compressed air

Check the pneumatic 
mechanism for air leaks

Perform the vacuum for 
all breaking units and support columns of CB

Fill the all phases of 
CB by SF6 gas and test (the gas protection stages, dew point, air volume 
percentage and decomposition test)

Measure the (closing & 
opening) times for each phase

sections.text: Preparation of switch on the Circuit Breaker

items:
Connect the terminals on 
CB sides and clean the insulation of CB

Switch on DC supply 
control of CB

Switch on the CB 
several times

Record counter reading 
of operation counter and no of operation hours of compressors

Measure the hot spots of 
all part of CB
